profiles.notes: Windows x64, Unity 2022.3.62f3 IL2CPP. Public release build 1.0.1.1 (公测). Rebound from the live dump of 2026-11-24, module base=0x7FFA1EEA0000 size=0x12871000.

unity.playerloop.dispatch.description: Walks Runtime.Extension.UPlayerLoop.s_Ticks and invokes every registered per-frame callback. The game's own frame boundary -- the correct place to hang a game-domain tick. 1.0.1.1 rebound: RVA 0x68C1F20 (was 0x5D53E00 on the 0.6.2.2 closed beta), token 0x6000F71 (was 0x6000F59). The body's first 24 bytes are byte-identical to the beta's, so the function was only relocated, not rewritten: `mov [rsp+8],rbx; push rdi; sub rsp,0x90; movaps [rsp+0x80],xmm6; cmp byte [rip+0xAC4B4BB],0; jne ...`. Prologue verified against GameAssembly.dll file offset 0x68C0F20 (this build keeps the il2cpp section at VA/Raw delta 0x1000). The 0.6.2.2 RVA lands on unrelated code here (`16 0B 48 85 C0 ...`), which is exactly the mismatch the host reported.

unity.transform.get_position.description: The entity walk's position read, called DIRECTLY instead of through il2cpp_runtime_invoke. The calling convention is not assumed: the 24 prologue bytes above are the first 24 bytes of THIS build's body and they decode as `mov [rsp+8],rbx; push rdi; sub rsp,0x20; xor eax,eax; mov rdi,rdx; mov [rcx],rax; mov rbx,rcx; mov [rcx+8],eax` -- the function ZEROES twelve bytes through RCX before anything else, so RCX is a caller-supplied Vector3 return buffer and RDX is `this`: void (*)(float* out, void* self, const MethodInfo*). The rest of the body (0xD0112B8..0xD0112EC) confirms it: `mov rax,[rip+0x452D6B9]; test rax,rax; jnz +0x13; lea rcx,[rip+0x8A8E35]  ; "UnityEngine.Transform::get_position_Injected(UnityEngine.Vector3&)"; call 0x10B61A0 (il2cpp_resolve_icall); mov [rip+0x452D6A1],rax` caches the resolved native icall in a global on first use, then `mov rdx,rbx; mov rcx,rdi; call rax` invokes it as (this, out), `mov rax,rbx` returns the buffer and `mov [rsp+8],rbx; add rsp,0x20; pop rdi; ret` restores. 1.0.1.1 rebound: RVA 0xD0112A0 (was 0xC687860 on 0.6.2.2); the prologue bytes are unchanged, so only the address moved. Located by anchoring on the il2cpp icall name string at RVA 0xD8BA100 and disassembling the referencing wrapper; the neighbour at 0xD011200 is get_lossyScale and must not be used, and 0xD011250 is the thunk that jumps straight to it.

azur.player.motion.move.description: Shared typed player motion owner. Hold skips native Move including PerformMovement/ResolveOverlaps; velocity mode changes only this call input.

azur.player.position.live_tick.description: m_check gates only ground/navmesh recovery and transfer. Original tick ledger/report still runs; each hook call restores the previous flag in finally.
